The '''Vaathkree Trade Corridor''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace trade route]] located in or near the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. It passed close to the planet [[Chrona/Legends|Chrona]].

It owed its name to its popularity with Vaathkree traders.<ref name="TEA" />
